name: motion-debugger
description: Design and build animated UI, inspect real local motion, and verify agent-written repairs with recorded evidence

interface.shortDescription: Design, build, inspect and repair animated UI
interface.longDescription: Portable frontend design, original 3D UI and prompt-to-page repair skills paired with local recorded-motion evidence. The host coding agent edits source; the MCP server captures, inspects and compares bounded local interactions.
defaultPrompt: Build this animated interface, inspect its running motion and repair observed defects.
Create an original interactive 3D UI and verify its interrupted motion.
Compare the before and after recorded motion evidence for this change.
